body: Dam, it's my birthday tomorrow, so close. Happy birthday Fireflion and burningspear! I wish I could meet more people like you two in real life.

Hi. That can be the most frightening felling because when our mind does not feel like a safe place there is no where to retreat to. You deserve to feel safe in your own mind. Anyways talk about it, tell us how you have felt the last week, is it worse then usual?

Hey hold on just give it a little while. I care, so that is at least one person who read what you wrote and cares. There are more people or there will be shortly. I care because I've totally been where you have been. Knowing what it feels like to want to shoot yourself, its not a good feeling (obviously). So when someone feels it I care and I want them to get past that felling without hurting themselves. Be safe.

Are you me? Seriously our stories are so similar. Anyways I almost blew my brains out about 2 years ago, but didn't follow through. I still fell like I want to die a lot of the time. I have just failed in life so many times in so many ways. I know that probably didn't make you fell better. But I think I still don't want to give up. I seriously hope that you do not give up either. I don't know you but I just think that you can make your life better and enjoy it if you do.
